properties.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 5 at 12:37PM EDT until October 8 at 5:00AM EDT by NWS Jacksonville FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 5 to 8 ft expected.

* WHERE...Northeast Florida coastal waters from St Augustine to
Flagler Beach out to 60 NM.

* WHEN...From 5 PM Tuesday to 5 AM EDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
